QuestInfo.name: Tiron's Dilemma
QuestInfo.0: Listen to #bTiron#k's problem and help him out.
QuestInfo.1: #bTiron#k asks you to purchase #b1 #t2460001##k from the General Store to help decode the password.

0.0: You're going around helping people, right? Right? Well, I'm a people with a problem!
0.1: I'm in charge of decoding enemy messages, but I lost my magnifying glass. My eyes are killing me. Seriously, they're about to fall out!
0.2: I don't have enough money to buy a magnifying glass....
0.3: You think you could lend me about #b5000#k mesos? I'm a little short...

no.0: Aw, I can't complete my mission without a magnifying glass...

1.0: You're going to lend me mesos?

yes.0: Sweet! I'll get that magnifying glass and crack the password for my mission! Thanks!

item.0: But... but I have to crack the password...
